howTo.name: Dermatology Website Build Process
howTo.description: A 7-step process for launching a high-performing dermatology website.

hero.title: Our Process
hero.description: No mystery, no scope creep, no hourly surprises. Every step has a written deliverable, an owner, and a deadline — so you always know what's happening this week and what's next.
hero.imageAlt: Illustration of a seven-step process journey, with glowing connected nodes ascending on a curved path

items.title: Discovery & Strategy
items.tagline: Understand the practice before we touch a pixel.
items.summary: A 60-minute strategy session plus a written brief. We audit your current site, review competitors, and lock down your patient persona, service priorities, and conversion goals — before design begins.

items.title: SEO & Technical Audit
items.tagline: Find the leaks before we build the boat.
items.summary: For redesigns, we run a full crawl of your existing site — indexing, Core Web Vitals, backlink profile, HIPAA gaps, and conversion bottlenecks. New sites get a keyword + SERP opportunity map instead.

items.title: Design & Prototype
items.summary: We design a bespoke visual system — colors, type, iconography, and component library — then produce clickable Figma prototypes of every key page. Two rounds of revisions are baked in.

items.title: Content & Copywriting
items.summary: Our medical copywriters draft every page in your voice — clinically accurate, patient-friendly, SEO-optimized. Runs in parallel with development so no timeline is added.

items.title: Development & Integration
items.tagline: Hand-coded. Fast. HIPAA-aware from line one.
items.summary: Semantic HTML, accessible components, image optimization, and Core Web Vitals baked in. Integrations — booking, EHR, chat, analytics — are wired up and tested end-to-end.

items.title: QA, Launch & Handoff
items.summary: 300-point pre-launch QA across browsers, devices, forms, and integrations. DNS cutover happens on your schedule with a rollback plan. You get a walkthrough video and a written playbook.

items.title: Growth & Optimization
items.tagline: Launch is the start, not the finish line.
items.summary: Monthly SEO, content, CRO experiments, and monitoring under your chosen bundle. Quarterly business reviews with your named account manager keep the roadmap on track.

principles.subtitle: The principles behind the process
principles.title: Six rules we don't bend.
principles.description: Every step above is downstream of these six commitments. They're what stop dermatology projects from becoming the horror stories you've heard.

items.title: HIPAA-first architecture
items.desc: Every form, every integration reviewed against HIPAA before it ships. No PHI in analytics.

items.title: Lighthouse 95+ or we rebuild
items.desc: Performance is a launch requirement, not an after-thought. We hit it or we fix it — on us.

items.title: One point of contact
items.desc: A named project lead from kickoff to handoff. No account-management merry-go-round.

items.title: Revisions built in
items.desc: Two design + two dev revision rounds included in every package. No nickel-and-diming.

items.title: Fixed timelines, weekly check-ins
items.desc: Written schedule at kickoff. Weekly progress calls. Delays flagged early, not at the deadline.

items.title: Slack channel, not ticketing
items.desc: Direct message the team any time. Response SLA measured in hours, not days.

rows.row: Slack access to the actual team

testimonial.quote: "The weekly check-ins alone were worth the price. We knew every Monday what shipped last week and what was landing this week. First project in five years that launched on the exact date they promised at kickoff."
testimonial.author: Dr. Anika Patel, MD, FAAD

items.q: How long does the full process take?
items.a: Most dermatology sites launch 4 to 6 weeks from kickoff. Starter (1-page) sites launch in 1 week. Enterprise multi-site builds take 10–14 weeks. You get a written schedule with weekly milestones at kickoff — no vague timelines.

items.q: What do you need from us during the build?
items.a: Roughly 3–5 hours per week: a 60-min kickoff call, weekly 30-min check-ins, doctor interviews for content (30 min each), and approvals via Figma / Slack within 48 hours. We do the heavy lifting — you approve, we ship.

items.q: Can we start with just design and add development later?
items.a: Yes. We offer standalone discovery + design engagements ($3,900) that produce a Figma prototype and design system you own. You can implement it yourself, hire another dev shop, or return to us later for build — no lock-in either way.

items.q: What if we need changes after launch?
items.a: Every package includes 30 days of post-launch fixes free of charge. After that, ongoing edits are covered by a monthly bundle (Essential, Growth, Marketing, or Full-Stack) or billed à la carte. You'll always see the invoice before we do the work.

items.q: Do you write the medical content, or do we?
items.a: Our medical copywriters draft everything, then your medical director reviews and approves. You never start with a blank page. If you prefer to write in-house, we discount the package accordingly.

items.q: How do you handle HIPAA compliance?
items.a: HIPAA-aware architecture is included in every build: no PHI in analytics, encrypted contact-form transport, masked field logging, and secure hosting. A signed BAA is included on Authority Brand and Enterprise plans, and available as an add-on elsewhere.
